cards.name: A-Sigardian Paladin
cards.oracleText:
As long as you've put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature this turn, Sigardian Paladin has trample and lifelink.
{G}{W}: Target creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it gains trample and lifelink until end of turn.

cards.name: A-Sigil of Myrkul
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, mill a card. When you do, if there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control and it gains deathtouch until end of turn. (To mill a card, put the top card of your library into your graveyard.)
